_comment: Static Unity pattern catalog used as few-shot context for code scanner prompts.

multiplayer_safety.example_good: [ClientRpc] void TakeDamageClientRpc(float dmg) { if (!IsOwner) return; health -= dmg; }
multiplayer_safety.notes: All NetworkVariable writes must happen on the server or owner. ClientRpc only runs on clients.

multiplayer_safety.example_bad: health.Value = 100f; // called from OnActionReceived on any client
multiplayer_safety.notes: NetworkVariable.Value can only be set by the server (default) or owner depending on write permission.

multiplayer_safety.pattern: Missing null check on NetworkObject before RPC
multiplayer_safety.example_good: var ph = target.GetComponent<PlayerHealth>(); if (ph != null && ph.IsSpawned) ph.TakeDamageServerRpc(10f);
multiplayer_safety.notes: NetworkObjects can be destroyed between frames; always null-check and check IsSpawned.

ml_agents.notes: Single large reward spikes cause PPO gradient instability. Cap per-component rewards at ±0.5.
Neural network inputs work best in [0,1] or [-1,1]. Unnormalised observations cause slow convergence.

ml_agents.example_bad: public override void CollectObservations(VectorSensor s) { if (done) EndEpisode(); }
ml_agents.example_good: Call EndEpisode() only from OnActionReceived() or Update().
ml_agents.notes: Calling EndEpisode() during CollectObservations triggers a double-reset and corrupts episode state.

ml_agents.pattern: RequestDecision called manually when DecisionRequester present
ml_agents.example_good: Let DecisionRequester handle all RequestDecision calls.
ml_agents.notes: Double requests per step cause observation-action mismatch in the replay buffer.

ml_agents.pattern: StatsRecorder accessed without Academy.Instance null check
ml_agents.notes: Academy.Instance is null outside of a running ML-Agents session (e.g. during Editor tests).

npc_dialogue.notes: Tag format changes will silently break all hardcoded comparisons.
Service is a scene singleton and may not be initialised during early Awake() calls.

npc_dialogue.pattern: LLM response text used in UI without sanitisation
npc_dialogue.notes: In WebGL builds, unsanitised LLM output in TextMeshPro can inject HTML/Unity rich text tags.

unity_best_practices.pattern: GetComponent in Update or hot path
unity_best_practices.example_good: Cache in Awake/Start: private Rigidbody m_Rb; void Awake() { m_Rb = GetComponent<Rigidbody>(); }
unity_best_practices.notes: GetComponent is a C++ call, ~10x more expensive than cached field access.

unity_best_practices.example_good: Use a static singleton pattern or cache the reference in Start().
unity_best_practices.notes: FindObjectOfType iterates all scene objects — O(n) per frame causes severe performance degradation.

unity_best_practices.example_good: Only update text when value changes: if (health != lastHealth) { debugLabel.text = ...; lastHealth = health; }
unity_best_practices.notes: String interpolation allocates a new string object each call, increasing GC pressure.

unity_best_practices.example_bad: private Transform playerTransform; // visible in Inspector? No.
unity_best_practices.notes: Following this project's m_ prefix convention also makes field ownership clear.
